note: Board: 07-more-screens/more-r3-share_shapes.jpg (the sheet boards more-r3-share_m, _m_square and _d frame the same PNG; the sheet chrome is PR B). The rows load the image route directly, signed out, as an OG crawler does: compare each against the matching card on the shapes board at 1x. Set CC_PHOTO_EVENT_ID to an upcoming event whose imageUrl or artistPhotoUrl is a JPEG or PNG (the tilted card and the blurred copy draw the photo), and CC_NO_PHOTO_EVENT_ID to one with neither (IdentityArt fills the card and the art's ground replaces the blurred copy). Pick events 2 or more days out to see 'N DAYS AWAY'; today reads TODAY, tomorrow TOMORROW, a past show draws no countdown. Walk by hand: a show with no genre (no chip), a long name (Story wraps to two lines, Square and Wide shrink then ellipsise), and a WebP-only photo (falls back to IdentityArt).
